typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Business_Date_Short as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> Getdatesloaded
Getdatesloaded sink(input(
		effectiveDate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		effectiveDate = Business_Date_Short),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
